lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaan paan seegaar birathe har ka(n)t bin kiu jeejeeai ||
lines.translation: Food, drink and decorations are useless; without my Husband Lord, how can I survive?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਰੈਨਿ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa piaasee rain dineear rahi na sakeeai ik tilai ||
lines.translation: I yearn for Him, and desire Him night and day. I cannot live without Him, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਸੰਤ ਦਾਸੀ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai sa(n)t daasee tau prasaad meraa pir milai ||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, O Saint, I am Your slave; by Your Grace, I meet my Husband Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਏਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sej ek priu sa(n)g daras na paaeeai raam ||
lines.translation: I share a bed with my Beloved, but I do not behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਤ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: avagan mohi anek kat mahal bulaaeeai raam ||
lines.translation: I have endless demerits - how can my Lord call me to the Mansion of His Presence?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨਿ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਅਨਾਥਿ ਬਿਨਵੈ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: niragun nimaanee anaath binavai milahu prabh kirapaa nidhe ||
lines.translation: The worthless, dishonored and orphaned soul-bride prays, "Meet with me, O God, treasure of mercy."

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਖੋਈਐ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੋਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਲਕ ਪੇਖਤ ਨਵ ਨਿਧੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhram bheet khoeeai sahaj soeeai prabh palak pekhat nav nidhe ||
lines.translation: The wall of doubt has been shattered, and now I sleep in peace, beholding God, the Lord of the nine treasures, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਲਾਲੁ ਆਵੈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: grihi laal aavai mahal paavai mil sa(n)g ma(n)gal gaaeeai ||
lines.translation: If only I could come into the Mansion of my Beloved Lord's Presence! Joining with Him, I sing the songs of joy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai sa(n)t saranee mohi daras dikhaaeeai ||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of the Saints; please, reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tan kai parasaad har har paaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, I have obtained the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: ichh pu(n)nee man saa(n)t tapat bujhaaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: My desires are fulfilled, and my mind is at peace; the fire within has been quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲਾ ਸੁ ਦਿਨਸ ਰੈਣੇ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸੁ ਘਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saphalaa s dinas raine suhaavee anad ma(n)gal ras ghanaa ||
lines.translation: Fruitful is that day, and beauteous is that night, and countless are the joys, celebrations and pleasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਲਾਲਨ ਕਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਭਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pragate gupaal gobi(n)d laalan kavan rasanaa gun bhanaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe, the Beloved Sustainer of the World, has been revealed. With what tongue can I speak of His Glory?

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਥਾਕੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਖੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhram lobh moh bikaar thaake mil sakhee ma(n)gal gaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Doubt, greed, emotional attachment and corruption are taken away; joining with my companions, I sing the songs of joy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਸੰਤ ਜੰਪੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai sa(n)t ja(n)pai jin har har sa(n)jog milaaiaa ||4||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Saint, who has led me to merge with the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bihaagaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa gur paarabraham poore anadin naam vakhaanaa raam ||
lines.translation: Shower Your Mercy upon me, O Guru, O Perfect Supreme Lord God, that I might chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਉਚਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee ucharaa har jas mithaa laagai teraa bhaanaa raam ||
lines.translation: I speak the Ambrosial Words of the Guru's Bani, praising the Lord. Your Will is sweet to me, Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar daiaa maiaa gopaal gobi(n)d koi naahee tujh binaa ||
lines.translation: Show kindness and compassion, O Sustainer of the Word, Lord of the Universe; without You, I have no other.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਮਰਥ ਅਗਥ ਅਪਾਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਜੀਉ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਮਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: samarath agath apaar pooran jeeu tan dhan tumh manaa ||
lines.translation: Almighty, sublime, infinite, perfect Lord - my soul, body, wealth and mind are Yours.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਨਾਥ ਚੰਚਲ ਬਲਹੀਨ ਨੀਚ ਅਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: moorakh mugadh anaath cha(n)chal balaheen neech ajaanaa ||
lines.translation: I am foolish, stupid, masterless, fickle, powerless, lowly and ignorant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak saran teree rakh lehu aavan jaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I seek Your Sanctuary - please save me from coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਹ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhah saranee paaeeai har jeeu gun gaavah har neetaa raam ||
lines.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints, I have found the Dear Lord, and I constantly sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੂਰਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਗਉ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਭ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhoor bhagatan kee man tan lagau har jeeu sabh patit puneetaa raam ||
lines.translation: Applying the dust of the devotees to the mind and body, O Dear Lord, all sinners are sanctified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤਾ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਹੋਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: patitaa puneetaa hohi tinh sa(n)g jinh bidhaataa paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The sinners are sanctified in the company of those who have met the Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤੇ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਹਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam raate jee daate nit dehi chaRahi savaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they are given the gift of the life of the soul; their gifts increase day by day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਆਤਮੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ridh sidh nav nidh har jap jinee aatam jeetaa ||
lines.translation: Wealth, the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, and the nine treasures come to those who meditate on the Lord, and conquer their own soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak vadabhaag paaeeahi saadh saajan meetaa ||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, it is only by great good fortune that the Holy Saints, the Lord's companions, are found, O friends. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee sach vana(n)jiaa har jeeu se poore saahaa raam ||
lines.translation: Those who deal in Truth, O Dear Lord, are the perfect bankers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਤਿੰਨ ਪਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahut khajaanaa ti(n)n pahi har jeeu har keeratan laahaa raam ||
lines.translation: They possess the great treasure, O Dear Lord, and they reap the profit of the Lord's Praise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨ ਲੋਭੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh na lobh biaapai jo jan prabh siu raatiaa ||
lines.translation: Sexual desire, anger and greed do not cling to those who are attuned to God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek jaanahi ek maanahi raam kai ra(n)g maatiaa ||
lines.translation: They know the One, and they believe in the One; they are intoxicated with the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਗਿ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਣੀ ਪੜੇ ਸਰਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਓਮਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: lag sa(n)t charanee paRe saranee man tinaa omaahaa ||
lines.translation: They fall at the Feet of the Saints, and seek their Sanctuary; their minds are filled with joy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਲੈ ਸੇਈ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak jin naam palai seee sache saahaa ||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, those who have the Naam in their laps are the true bankers. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak soee simareeai har jeeu jaa kee kal dhaaree raam ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meditate on that Dear Lord, who supports all by His almighty strength.
